welcome:
Welcome to the containerd / nerdctl CLI Playground.
Explore containers at the runtime level — nerdctl (Docker-compatible), ctr (low-level), and crictl (CRI).
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

scenarios.title: Debug Containers on a Kubernetes Node

steps.instruction: You have SSH-ed into a Kubernetes worker node. First, list the containerd namespaces to see what is running.
Kubernetes containers run in the 'k8s.io' namespace. List running containers there.
The 'payment-svc' container shows high restart count (attempt 4). Inspect it for details.
Check the logs of the failing container to find the root cause.
The logs mention an image pull error. List images on this node to verify what is cached.
Check the pod sandbox status — maybe the pod itself is unhealthy.
Let's go deeper. Use ctr to list snapshots and check for disk pressure.
Finally, check the low-level containerd task list to see running and stopped tasks.
Start by checking the nerdctl and containerd versions on this node.
Build a container image from the Dockerfile in the current directory.
Verify the image was created by listing local images.
Create a custom bridge network for our application stack.
Run the application container on the new network, mapping port 8080.
steps.hint: Try: nerdctl run -d --name myapp --net app-net -p 8080:8080 myapp:v1.0

steps.instruction: Check that the container is running.
Now bring up the full stack using compose (app + redis + postgres).
Verify all compose services are running.

commands.help:
Available commands:

  — nerdctl (Docker-compatible CLI for containerd) —
  nerdctl ps / ps -a              — List running / all containers
  nerdctl images                  — List local images
  nerdctl run                     — Run a container
  nerdctl build                   — Build an image from Dockerfile
  nerdctl pull / push             — Pull or push images
  nerdctl logs                    — View container logs
  nerdctl inspect                 — Inspect container or image
  nerdctl exec                    — Execute command in container
  nerdctl stop / rm / rmi         — Stop, remove container or image
  nerdctl compose up/down/ps      — Docker Compose compatible
  nerdctl network ls/create       — Manage networks
  nerdctl volume ls               — List volumes
  nerdctl namespace ls            — List containerd namespaces
  nerdctl system prune            — Clean unused resources
  nerdctl info / version          — System information

  — ctr (low-level containerd CLI) —
  ctr containers list             — List containers
  ctr images list                 — List images
  ctr snapshots list              — List snapshots
  ctr namespaces list             — List namespaces
  ctr tasks list                  — List running tasks
  ctr content list                — List content blobs

  — crictl (CRI-compatible CLI for Kubernetes nodes) —
  crictl ps                       — List containers (CRI)
  crictl images                   — List images (CRI)
  crictl pods                     — List pod sandboxes
  crictl logs                     — View container logs
  crictl inspect                  — Inspect a container

  scenario                        — Start a guided lab
  clear                           — Clear the terminal
  help                            — Show this help
